rows.statement: Pro football hall: a finalist is elected with at least 80 percent favourable votes of the full selection committee (unchanged by the 2026 overhaul for the 2027 class).

sources.citation: Pro Football Hall of Fame, Selection Process FAQ
sources.quote: Those who receive at least 80% favorable votes will be elected

sources.citation: NFL.com, 'Bill Belichick, Robert Kraft finalists, Class of 2026'
sources.quote: To be inducted, a candidate must garner at least 80% of the full Selection Committee votes.

sources.citation: Associated Press via theScore, Hall selection overhaul (Sep 2026)
sources.quote: Voters will be able to vote for six people with 80% needed.
Voters will be able to vote for six people with 80% needed.

statusHistory.reason: Hall FAQ primary text plus NFL.com and AP

rows.statement: Pro football hall: a coach must be out of the game at least one season before he can be considered (cut from five seasons in August 2024).

sources.citation: Pro Football Hall of Fame, Selection Process FAQ
sources.quote: Coaches must have been out of the game for at least one season.
the waiting period for coaches from five seasons to one
Previously, coaches had to wait five seasons after retiring to be considered.

statusHistory.reason: Hall FAQ primary text plus ESPN and Yahoo

rows.statement: Pro football hall: the selection committee is 28 people from the 2027 class (25 voting, 3 rotating non-voting), down from about 50.

sources.quote: The Hall is cutting the size of the selection committee from 50 people to 28
there will be 27 at-large members, including some of those Hall of Famers, and one PFWA representative.

rows.notes: Both copies are one AP wire story. Hall FAQ still describes the old panel. Two more independent sources owed.

rows.statement: Pro football hall: one coach is named a finalist for each class.
rows.validFor: from August 2024; restated for the 2027 class

sources.quote: one coach will be named a finalist for each Hall of Fame class.
There will also be one coaching candidate and one contributor picked as a finalist.
